name: The nephew of Ta'abbata Sharran
bio: The speaker of “In the mountain pass” is introduced in Abd al-Rahman al-Sa'eed’s transmission as the sister’s son of Ta'abbata Sharran, the Fahmi poet Thabit ibn Jabir. He asks Sawad ibn Amr for wine and speaks of the dead man as his uncle. Al-Zabidi cites Ibn Barri for identifying the nephew with al-Shanfara, while al-Bakri calls him Khufaf ibn Nudba. Other authorities give the elegy to Ta'abbata Sharran himself or to the Basran transmitter Khalaf al-Ahmar. The accounts leave the speaker’s personal name and dates uncertain.
